purpose: Measure one partition with one consumer at the expected 1200/s hot-partition input before interpreting the D-related contrast
prerequisite: Complete and inspect all eight core trials first; respect the same deadline and storage limits.
label: single-partition-capacity-v4
qualification: Complete evidence, at least 98% target admissions, no ownership changes through production and drain, at least 90% lag coverage.
Inspect positive backlog growth in both 60-second evaluation halves and achieved processing throughput below admitted input. Do not infer overload from the configured input alone.
If this does not qualify, retain it and do not describe the later 80%-hot workload as an established dedicated-partition capacity limit.
limitations: This is a single calibration on the recorded node, not a capacity estimate valid for every shared node or future time.
The later 60-partition comparison retains sparse cold traffic and may change the hot owner; report those differences.
